text: BP p.l.c. is a listed company whose largest shareholder is the asset manager BlackRock. Its Annual Report and Form 20-F 2025 lists, as per each holder's most recent notification, BlackRock, Inc. (7.37%), Elliott Investment Management, L.P. (5.00%) and Norges Bank (3.99%) as holding 3% or more of the voting rights in its ordinary shares.

source.name: bp: Annual Report and Form 20-F 2025, Shareholder information, 'Major shareholders' - 'Substantial shareholders'

additionalSources.name: Reuters, via Yahoo Finance UK: Elliott increases BP stake to just over 5%
additionalSources.quote: This makes Elliott BP's second-biggest shareholder after Blackrock at 9.2% and ahead of Vanguard at 4.95%, according to LSEG data.
